coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Matches 7 of 11 ground-truth items (64%): all three prompting methods, all three tasks, and per-instance inference timing with a base-10 logarithmic display specified through powers-of-ten axis ticks.
coverage.design_error_analysis: Does not specify the NVIDIA A100-PCIE-40GB GPU, fixed random seeds, or a shared installation of all prompting frameworks and BoT repository configuration. Specifies 5 repeats rather than 10 repeated runs per task. The timing match is qualified: raw seconds are the primary dependent variable, with logarithmic scaling only in the figure specification.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion_output is empty, so it does not semantically match the ground-truth conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: Provides neither the expected overall increase in BoT inference time nor the task-specific logarithmic timing values, including the Game of 24 exception where BoT is faster than PAL.
